_comment: Append-only dated star ledger. Keyed by GitHub's IMMUTABLE numeric repo id (databaseId), never by owner/name: a rename defeats a name-keyed record and renames are exactly what evasion looks like. A date, once written, is never rewritten. `slugs` is the rename trail for that id, oldest first. Generated by .github/scripts/snapshot-stars.mjs; do not hand-edit.
